design_decision_promotion_vs_serving: The design's NO_FIT law ('Reserve ... before admission', designs/02) is an ADMISSION law: publish-side _admit_locked refuses when the budget cannot be met after LRU eviction among unleased entries. Serving is never refused: a tier-2 promotion that cannot fit even after eviction SERVES WITHOUT RETAINING (counted promote_skips) — the produced path would have allocated the same decoded layer anyway, and refusing to serve would force a rebuild of data the store already holds.
